252: A twice-divorced mother of three who sees an injustice, takes on the bad guy and wins -- with a little help from her push-up bra. Erin goes to work for an attorney and comes across medical records describing illnesses clustered in one nearby town. She starts investigating and soon exposes a monumental cover-up.
She brought a small town to its feet and a huge company to its knees.

She Passed Out On Cary! No Wonder . . . She's just discovered his favorite aunts have poisoned their 13th gentleman friend!

A romantic comedy you can't refuse

Can a great man be a good man?

All America wants to meet the “Mr. Deeds” of 1941!

A Holiday Comedy Unlike Any Other!
5116: Six strangers find themselves in circumstances beyond their control, and must use their wits to survive.

Centuries before the exploration of space, there was another voyage into the unknown.

Abandoned as a child. Raised by the dark.

When the end is here the Alps are near.

Journey to a place where nothing is as it appears!

First Truffaut gave us The 400 Blows. Then Stolen Kisses... and now Bed and Board.

Play the game on top of the game.

It lasted 30 days... You will remember it as long as you live.

Thou shalt not suffer a witch to live.

The night of the man who chewed asphalt.

The only thing they don't use... is the scream.

He's conned his way into Oxford University . . . now he's learning to be a WINNER!

The Scream of the Screen-Buster in a Matrimonial Maelstrom – Buster's Adventure in Married Bliss.

It will shock you but it will hold you spellbound to the end!

But this superstar sleuth is about to find out just how mistaken he was...

Cross Her Heart and Hope to Die

22524: In the sequel of "Ants in the Pants" we again meet Flo and his friends.

We're haunted by what we leave behind.

Go ahead and say it...I'm no good!

This year, there will be no leftovers.

Good help is hard to find.

Jab footega ghada... ghapla hoga bada

26620: A grandmother’s mishap with a social media post causes consternation amongst her children and threatens the prospect of her granddaughter’s wedding.

POW's in Vietnam... starved in captivity... released with a taste for human flesh.

This divorce is going to be a nightmare.

29436: Three mercenaries extracting a druglord out of Guinea-Bissau are forced to hide in the mystical region of Saloum, Senegal.
Once upon a time in Africa...
29692: Set in the backdrop of the seventeenth century, the royal family of Kottayam is ruled by Pazhassi. The British government begins to impose heavy taxes on the locals in the Thalassery region of Kerala.

Which one of you will go to hell?

Without A Win. But Never Without Hope.

The ghosts of your past would like to have a word with you.

She turned down Hollywood to become Goebbels' lover: Lída Baarová

Lawless cops and a savage killer battle to the bitter end!

...and then he made us play that silly game...

Adventure Crashes To The Screen . . . Romance, Plus! Action, Plus! . . . Amid the Teeming Jungle!

35324: When a small outpost is ambushed, a US Army squad must take the battle below ground on a high-stakes mission in a new type of warfare the likes of which they have never seen.

all the power on earth could not change his familys destiny...

A fearless life.  A reckless love.

The phone sex line was for fantasy... now it's for murder!

Francesca is alone with a daughter and without a dime. But she's beautiful

It's never too late to find your way home

40444: A group of commandos heads into the jungles of Venezuela on a highly classified mission and encounters a robotic killing machine.

Jean becomes a big press baron and an ardent advocate of collaboration with the occupying forces, while Otto becomes the Reich’s ambassador in Paris. Corinne, meanwhile, finds herself thrown into the lion’s pit.

Asuna, who cleared the first floor of the floating iron castle of Aincrad, joined up with Kirito and continued her journey to reach the top floor. And meanwhile, behind the scenes exists a mysterious figure pulling the strings…

Behind the masks. Beneath the helmets. Big people. Small roles.
41468: A husband and wife are locked inside a single hotel room with a stranger named Ploy. Subtle suspicions build up to jealousy as the young woman triggers devastating consequences for the couple.
Every relationship has an expiration date.

Gradually, their relationship turns into a conflicting passion, oscillating between exploitation and protection, jealousy and complicity.
42492: Two single parents, one man and one woman, along with their kids, have to involuntarily share a house for their holidays.

He scratched her tender skin and found a savage!

In ENEMY TERRITORY they take no prisoners. You've got to kill your way out.

Intent on protecting Yuna at all costs, Van must uncover the true cause of the plague ravaging the kingdom—and its possible cure.
44540: Two modern women and their free-spirited mother struggle to balance their private, professional and family lives.

45564: When a couple is taken hostage in their home by an intruder, a simple home invasion robbery turns into something much more complicated...
45820: A mad scientist ignores each of his creations when he shifts his attention to the next monster. His first creation, Stitch Head, searching for purpose, takes it upon himself to look after all the other monsters.
Being different is the main attraction.

Coming Soon - To a backyard near you.

In order to clear his name, he must betray the deadly crooks he's been working for.
"Give her the works til she tells where the jewels are hidden."

Samir has no choice but to fly in turn also.

47868: An uptight bachelor tries his luck with a computer dating service and gets matched up with his polar opposite.
What do you do when everything between the two of you seems wrong? ...fall in love.

One woman's journey to inspire everyBODY

Hayao Miyazaki's masterpiece comes to life like never before.

What happens when uncorrupted people come to a vicious city

He who controls the cops controls the city
